Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device

Class DeviceAuthorizationClient

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device.DeviceAuthorizationClient
@Component @Profile("device-flow") public class DeviceAuthorizationClient extends Object
Calls the standard device flow endpoints of the authorization server. They belong to Spring Authorization Server, so there is no contract of ours to generate a client from.
